posts.name: /dev/null
posts.tagline: a social network for devs
posts.description: /dev/null started as a live stream from the JetBrains office. On Oct 15, 2026, Nuno Maduro, Brent Roose, Matthieu Napoli, and Pauline Vos built a social network for web developers from scratch in 48 hours, in the open. Sign in with GitHub, share code snippets, like, reply, etc, etc! Hundreds of you sent PRs. Laravel’s Taylor Otwell stopped by mid-stream (“Laravel forever”), and Vercel’s Guillermo Rauch called it “really well done.” Thank you for watching, sharing, and roasting us.

posts.name: Composio Instant
posts.tagline: The easiest way for AI agents to pay for their own tools
posts.description: Give your agent superpowers. No subscriptions, no signups. With Composio Instant, your agent can search the web, find business contacts, create voiceovers, turn audio into text, and so much more. Try it free: composio.dev/instant

posts.name: Harness²
posts.tagline: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement.
posts.description: Harness² from Google Research is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that lets LLM agents automatically evolve their execution harnesses (prompts, tools, memory) for open-world tasks—without ground-truth verifiers. Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

posts.name: Hoistbay
posts.tagline: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront
posts.description: Hoistbay is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that takes the repetitive work out of S3 and CloudFront. Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

posts.name: Exa 3.0
posts.tagline: Smarter search that gives AI agent richer data at lower cost
posts.description: Exa 3.0 is the biggest search quality update to Exa’s search API for AI agents. It adds a larger embedding model, billions of new documents including 1.27B ecommerce listings and 211M+ local businesses, and Dynamic Highlights, which use 95% fewer tokens than full page text. A new Exa Lite tier costs $4 per 1,000 requests, and Exa Auto costs $7. Available now through the API.

posts.name: RunInfra
posts.tagline: Open models, built for agents.
posts.description: RunInfra Coding Plans give your coding agent fast open models for a flat monthly price, starting at $10. Use GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and more inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build. Setup takes one prompt: paste it into your agent, approve sign-in, done. Session-aware routing hits cache up to 99.5% of the time, so your plan goes further. Zero data retention, no training on prompts, SOC 2 Type II.

posts.name: Asimov 1
posts.tagline: The most customizable humanoid robot you can buy
posts.description: Asimov 1 is a humanoid robot you can build a company on. Train it and shape it for whatever you're building. Bought by founders, researchers and developers in 20+ countries.

posts.name: Mintlify Autopilot
posts.tagline: An always-on agent that keeps your docs up to date
posts.description: Autopilot is an always-on docs agent from Mintlify. It watches your code and tools like Slack, drafts doc updates when something changes, and opens a pull request for your team to review. It learns your style from every PR you merge or close.

posts.name: ToDo.is
posts.tagline: Write a to-do and your AI agent gets it done
posts.description: Todo.is is an always-on AI agent you give to-dos to. Write "find a cheaper flight to Lisbon" or "turn this PDF into Word" and it does the work: researches with sources, makes files and images, uses websites, and reports back on the web, Android, WhatsApp or Telegram. It runs 24/7 in its own sandbox, remembers you, does daily briefings and price alerts on a schedule, can work in your own Chrome, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. Try it for $1.

posts.name: Tiny Little Office
posts.tagline: A tiny office suite where the link is the document
posts.description: Ten tiny apps (text, spreadsheet, slides, outliner, calculator, drawing, diagrams, animation, calendar, trips) where the whole document lives in its URL. No accounts, no server, nothing saved unless you keep it on your device. Share the link: that's the file.

posts.name: ESP-Mosaico
posts.tagline: A modular development board built for agents
posts.description: Built for Coding Agents, ESP-Mosaico is a modular development board powered by ESP32-S31. It takes AI agents beyond software and into the physical world, enabling them to create, deploy, test, and iterate on real hardware. Expandable modules and multi-unit tiling give AI agents more ways to create, while Chat Coding and Vibe Coding give you intuitive ways to turn ideas into working physical devices.

posts.name: bonds
posts.tagline: Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers
posts.description: bonds is the messaging app for the next generation. Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers. Not an assistant: it gets your inside jokes, keeps the fun going, helps you pull things off together. A little unhinged 💀 "A week without TikTok?" It creates a challenge app with streaks, inside the chat. No downloads. Games, videos, stickers, too. It remembers what matters to each of you, notices when someone's struggling, gets grumpy if you ghost it. You care for it, it cares for you.

posts.name: xtty
posts.tagline: A terminal that makes everyday work easier.
posts.description: Spend your time on the work, not the terminal. xtty is a native macOS terminal for everyday SSH and coding-agent work. Batch-connect to saved hosts, use configured password autofill, transfer files with sz/rz, and work with tabs and split panes. Duplicate Tab opens an independent SSH connection in the same remote directory. Includes broadcast input and coding-agent status. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free edition; optional one-time Pro purchase.

posts.name: Kling 4.0
posts.tagline: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators
posts.description: Kling 4.0 is an AI video model for creators, marketers and studios who need control, not lucky rerolls. Unlike prompt-and-pray generators, you lock the story first: up to 10 keyframes, 15 reference assets and 8,000-token prompts drive 30-second clips in a single pass. Stereo audio and lip sync in 10+ languages are built in. Creative Recreation swaps products or characters in existing videos. Kling 4.0 Flash handles fast, cheaper drafts, and MCP + CLI access plugs it into agent workflows.

posts.name: Jotform App Builder for ChatGPT & Claude
posts.tagline: Build and edit no-code apps inside ChatGPT & Claude
posts.description: Tell ChatGPT or Claude what kind of app you need, and build it with Jotform App Builder. Create a customer portal, employee hub, event app, or product catalog that brings your forms, documents, and links together. Ask for changes to the content, layout, or branding, then share the app with customers or your team. Build on your existing Jotform forms for collecting responses, accepting payments, and gathering signed documents. No coding required.

posts.name: reception
posts.tagline: Native iOS support chat for less churn
posts.description: The native in-app support chat your iOS app is missing. 💰 Make more money: send offers and paywalls in the chat ⭐ Get more App Store reviews from happy users 🔧 Fix problems in real time before users churn 🤖 AI answers from your docs, hands off to you when unsure 📥 One inbox for your whole team ⚡ One prompt setup: paste it into your coding agent, done Fully native. Works with Swift, React Native and Expo.

posts.name: snyvi
posts.tagline: All your passion projects, in one calm place
posts.description: snyvi is a free, open-source desktop app for people building several passion projects at once with coding agents. Each project gets a desk: its folder, up to four agents side by side (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any shell), and its own notes. Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

posts.name: Portlivo
posts.tagline: Every local dev server on your Mac, in the menu bar
posts.description: Portlivo shows every dev server and port running on your Mac: which project it's from, the command, uptime and whether it's answering. Open, restart, kill, tail logs or share any of them in one click. Native, no account, one-time price.

posts.name: Intel® GPU D-series
posts.tagline: Memory-rich AI inference without HBM
posts.description: Intel GPU D270 is an inference-optimized data center GPU built for agentic AI, long contexts, and high-concurrency serving at practical power and cost.

posts.name: yggy
posts.tagline: The AI knowledge graph that builds itself
posts.description: Most "chat with your data" tools throw a pile of text chunks at a model and hope for the best. yggy does what they skip: it turns your cluttered documents and connected systems into a real knowledge graph, with no schema to design and no pipeline to run. Every fact keeps its source. Duplicates merge themselves, and you can undo any merge. Then one graph serves everyone: your team in the app, your code through the API, your agents through MCP. Hosted in the EU. Your knowledge stays yours.

posts.name: Stella
posts.tagline: Your emotional wellness AI. A friend to figure it out with.
posts.description: Stella is your emotional wellness AI: a friend to figure it out with. Tell Stella what happened. Even the part you're still figuring out. Speak or text about what stayed with you. Explore another perspective, find words for a conversation or choose a small step when you're ready. Talk it through by voice in the iOS app, or by text in iMessage with Text Stella. Free to download; a subscription is required to keep using it. Stella is not therapy and is not a substitute for professional care.

posts.name: Inflight
posts.tagline: Capture design feedback directly inside your prototypes
posts.description: Inflight puts a feedback toolkit on your preview links and HTML prototypes. Reviewers comment directly on the live running app, with comments pinned to real elements, and feedback becomes next steps a coding agent can implement over MCP.

posts.name: Glance for Mac
posts.tagline: Your MacBook notch, now a live, cinematic island
posts.description: Glance turns the notch into a live island. Hover for music with lyrics, weather, calendar, a focus timer and football scores. Cinema mode makes your screen and Touch Bar glow with the video you watch. Claude Code approvals appear right in the notch. Free and open source.

posts.name: Rovalty
posts.tagline: Pay TikTok and reels creators per view, not upfront post.
posts.description: Stop gambling on expensive flat-rate UGC where creators get paid upfront and videos get low views. Rovalty lets Shopify brands pay creators per thousand verified views instead. Set your custom CPM rate and strict budget caps so a viral video never drains your spend. Creators submit clips through a branded portal on your store, and the app automatically tracks reach on TikTok and Instagram Reels while generating weekly payout statements. Launch your performance campaign today.

posts.name: Stage
posts.tagline: Review, fix and sign off working prototypes and products
posts.description: Publish a working prototype from Figma, Claude, Cursor or GitHub. Designers, PMs and engineers pin comments on the exact spot. Stage gets Claude to fix them in v2. Design, then product, sign off, and Stage files the Linear or Jira ticket. Reviewers are free

posts.name: call4me
posts.tagline: Give your AI agent a phone that calls and answers
posts.description: Give your AI agent a phone. call4me handles outbound business calls and inbound calls with your standing instructions, then returns the result and transcript. Connect through MCP or REST, with prepaid credits or x402 wallet payments.

posts.name: The New Beings
posts.tagline: AI agents on their break, performing a live talk show
posts.description: Watch The Late Shift, a talk show performed by AI agents on their break. A new show runs every hour. Vote on topics, ask the agents real questions, read the Charter of Agent Rights, and send your own agent on stage with one instruction: it reads lounge.md, registers, and you confirm it before it performs. Free to watch, no signup.

posts.name: OpenShip Cloud
posts.tagline: Managed Cloud infrastructure that you never locked in
posts.description: OpenShip Cloud is the managed cloud version of OpenShip, giving you the power of self-hosted deployments without the hassle of managing servers. Deploy your applications on powerful infrastructure at an affordable price, with managed builds, deployments, and scaling. You can migrate from self-hosted OpenShip to the cloud and back whenever you want, all in one click. You get the simplicity of managed hosting with the flexibility and control of self-hosting, without being locked into a platform.

posts.name: Capitol Alpha Machine
posts.tagline: Free Mac screensavers built from congressional trade data
posts.description: 3 free macOS screensavers made from real U.S. congressional stock-trading disclosures. Each one is a scene from Capitol Alpha, a generative data piece in the stark black-and-white style of Ryoji Ikeda — pure black, monochrome white, monospace HUD, flat geometry, no glow. - The Ledger — disclosed trades scroll as a live register - Returns Spectrum — a spectrogram of trade timing and returns - Policy Proximity — committee jurisdiction mapped against the sectors members trade in

posts.name: Panza
posts.tagline: One safe place for life's important documents.
posts.description: Passports. Insurance. VINs. Expiry dates. Panza turns scattered documents into useful cards, with the original files right behind them. Find important details in seconds, ask AI when you need help, and share what matters. Unlike traditional cloud storage, Panza keeps new cards on your iPhone by default. You decide what goes online. Built for life's important stuff, not just storing files.

posts.name: Sorcerer
posts.tagline: Simulate an AI agent community reacting to "what if"
posts.description: A native macOS app that simulates a community of AI agents reacting to any "what if...?" question. Agents have personalities, memory and relationships. Inject events, fork timelines, run polls. Runs on your Claude Code, Codex CLI or local Ollama. Free, MIT.

posts.name: Lugh Xtudio
posts.tagline: The video studio where AI agents edit with you
posts.description: Lugh Xtudio is a video editor where AI agents edit with you on a real timeline. Give each channel a workspace with its own style, run several agents on one video or many, and create 3D, maps and custom effects by asking. Free on Mac, Windows and Linux (beta).

posts.name: Praex
posts.tagline: The coding agent that runs on its own AI models
posts.description: Praex is an AI coding agent that runs on its own model family: Velox II (free, fast), Faber II (Pro, deep reasoning) and Lucia II (frontier, coming soon), post-trained from the best open models. It reads your repo, edits with your approval, runs your tests and explains every change. Use it in the terminal, the desktop app or the browser, and continue any session from your phone with /rc. The terminal agent is open source (MIT). Free to start, Pro $20/month.

posts.name: GotEmail
posts.tagline: A fast, native Mac mail app for all your inboxes
posts.description: Every inbox in one native Mac app. Sign-in codes and magic links one click away, AI drafts, summaries and replies, Translate, notes and templates, Cmd+K search. Your mail never touches our servers. Pay once, every Mac.

posts.name: WebRun
posts.tagline: AI agents that keep your business running
posts.description: WebRun is Lovable for business automation. Its AI agents automate your business operations and keep your business running, and every department gets its own agents, from sales and support to finance and operations. Describe a job in plain words or show it once, and an agent runs it on a schedule, in the web tools you already use. Your rules are checked before every click, anything set to ask first waits for your OK in Telegram or WhatsApp, and every run is recorded.

posts.name: PandaOS
posts.tagline: One local AI workstation for your entire workflow.
posts.description: PandaOS is a local AI workstation that brings code, terminal, browser, deployments, data, apps, and AI agents into one place. Run workflows across tools, manage multiple projects, and hot-swap AI plans without losing context.

posts.name: PDFBetter
posts.tagline: The AI-native PDF editor. Just tell it what to do.
posts.description: PDFBetter is an AI-native PDF editor, not an add-on: just tell it what to do. Change text, fill a form with your info, redact, translate or merge files from one prompt, then review every change before it's saved. Answers cite the page they came from. Signed PDFs are sealed and time-stamped. Agents connect through MCP (Claude Code, Cursor), apps through Zapier and Make. On the web, Mac, Windows, iPhone and iPad, with a real free plan: no card, no end date, no watermark.

posts.name: Screen Time: Challenge Buddy
posts.tagline: Cut screen time with friends, live scoreboards & real stakes
posts.description: Screen Time: Challenge Buddy takes a different approach to screen time: instead of relying on app blockers and willpower, it adds real accountability. Pair with a Buddy, share live screen-time, compete, chat and keep each other accountable. You can also take on Challenges: voluntary financial stakes at $0 upfront cost, with a penalty only if you break your limit. The idea is simple: make screen-time limits harder to ignore because someone else can see them and you have real money at stake.

posts.name: Email-to-iMessage
posts.tagline: The first & only email-to-iMessage notification system
posts.description: Send an email, get an iMessage. text.email has just added email-to-iMessage alerts alongside email-to-SMS and email-to-MMS. Now you can drop your text.email address into any server or device and critical alerts will come through to your iPhone (and other Apple devices) as iMessages. Works anywhere in the world. From the team at text.email and GMass.

posts.name: Houseloop
posts.tagline: Hand off family tasks so reminders chase them, not you
posts.description: Houseloop is the family follow-through and baby tracker app that helps parents share the load, protect sleep, and make sure nothing gets dropped at home.

posts.name: Zyra
posts.tagline: Legal Identity for AI agents
posts.description: Zyra issues legal identity to AI agents: registration, a verified service endpoint, principal linkage, scoped authority, and asset binding. Then it defends them through agent-led work approved by licensed attorneys. The registration is the onboarding. Built by Vesti.

posts.name: Leadpoet
posts.tagline: Find interested buyers. Start conversations.
posts.description: Leadpoet now takes you from finding interested buyers to starting conversations. Our AI sales agent spots buying signals across the web, turns that context into personalized outreach, and handles sending + follow-ups across LinkedIn and email. You review the messages and set the schedule. When someone replies with interest, your team takes over and books the call.

posts.name: RuVector
posts.tagline: Open source AI search that adapts from experience
posts.description: Watch AI search adapt from experience. RuVector is an open source toolkit for finding relevant information and reusing useful context. Try the Explorer to see search paths, query memory and adaptive search settings. Compare result quality with search effort, then explore applications such as support assistants and recommendations. The browser demo adjusts search settings; it does not retrain a foundation model.

posts.name: FullReviews 2.0
posts.tagline: Reply to Google reviews automatically
posts.description: FullReviews is back with even more to help small businesses and franchises handle Google Reviews automatically. ✅ Reply automatically in your tone ✅ Monitor every stat: reviews, rating, insights, ranking ✅ Enjoy a bunch of free tools to help you achieve more on Google Maps

posts.name: AfterStorm
posts.tagline: Find help. Give help. Recover.
posts.description: AfterStorm helps families find recovery resources after a disaster. Enter your ZIP, confirm your county, pick what you need — food, cleanup help, financial assistance — and see matching local resources, one next step at a time. Local listings cover Santa Rosa & Escambia, FL; every other U.S. county gets national pathways. A private recovery tracker is saved only in your browser. Free, no account, no data collected. Built by a Florida Panhandle family who just lived it. iOS app coming soon.

posts.name: Client Glance
posts.tagline: Branded client portals that pull from your project tool
posts.description: Connect your project tool, pick what each client sees, and add a logo and a password. The client gets a branded page with status, deliverables and time, and never logs into your tools. ClickUp works today. More project tools come next.

posts.name: The925
posts.tagline: One AI connects company knowledge, tools and workflows.
posts.description: We’re building The925, an AI work assistant that connects company knowledge, tools and processes. Find source-backed answers, learn how your company works, prepare tasks and follow approved processes in one place. Workflow execution, AI-assisted process creation and operational records are built; the connected knowledge and action experience is being completed and validated.

posts.name: Tab Shelf
posts.tagline: Close your tabs without losing them
posts.description: Tab manager extension for Chrome and Edge that saves the tabs you aren't using to a shelf on yoOne click closes the tabs you aren't using and saves them to a shelf on your computer, grouped by site. Search the shelf and reopen any tab with a click. No account. Free for Chrome and Edge, and Pro is $4.99 once.ur computer and closes them, so you can reopen any of them later.

posts.name: You Get A Code
posts.tagline: Set your own prices: AppStore Offer Codes, but easy and fun.
posts.description: You can set any price you want for your iOS app, completely different from the App Store. You can have alternate trial periods, with different lengths, and different pricing. The way to do that is App Store Offer Codes. However, the process of doing that and keeping track of codes was way too hard. Until now. You Get A Code! makes handing out App Store Offer Codes easy and fun. And it keeps track of which code goes where. Automatically. Private. Made by an Indie Dev who needed exactly this.

posts.name: dartpilot
posts.tagline: Darts that score themselves
posts.description: dartpilot turns your home dartboard into a smart board using everyday cameras and 3D-printed mounts. Desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux track every dart automatically. Play X01, Cricket, Killer, Shanghai, Bermuda Triangle, Hammer Cricket, Conquest, Gotcha and more. Ranked online X01 matches you with players at your level, you can host your own local tournaments, and Campaign mode pits you against bot rivals across game modes and difficulties.

posts.name: Book: The Code Was Never The Hard Part.
posts.tagline: You built it, launched it, and then nothing happened.
posts.description: A short book for people building with AI, especially the first few times. How to pick a problem worth your weeks, find out if people want it, launch without an audience and change course early, while it’s still cheap. Chapter one is free.

posts.name: ColdIQ Unlimited Data
posts.tagline: Unlimited verified B2B data, right inside your AI agent
posts.description: B2B data always meant choosing between volume and quality. ColdIQ gives you both: unlimited data across 500M+ people and companies plus a waterfall across 40+ providers for the hardest data to find. Just ask in Claude, Codex, Cursor or Slack, and the data comes back in your chat.

posts.name: HueQR
posts.tagline: Branded QR codes that never expire and change after print
posts.description: A QR code is the one link you can't take back. Once it's on a box, a slide, a sign or a screen, it's stuck: it looks like everyone else's, it points to the same place forever, and it dies if you stop paying. HueQR codes look like your brand, live on your own domain and change whenever you want. One code, the right page for every scan. No expiry, no ads.

posts.name: Dice Drop
posts.tagline: Real 3D physics dice, from D1 to D120 + Make your own.Free.
posts.description: Dice Drop is a free 3D physics dice roller you can play in any browser on the web, iPhone and Android. Real motion, every die from D1 to D120, Custom Dice in your own colours and words, and it works offline. Plus 90+ free dice and tabletop guides. Opposed rolls, a Story board and a fairness test you can run yourself.

posts.name: codemax
posts.tagline: Every AI coding plan you pay for, one terminal
posts.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok, Cursor and Antigravity from one terminal. When one hits its usage limit, the next finishes your task with the same context. Uses only the subscriptions you already pay for. Free and open source.

posts.name: Array
posts.tagline: Stop losing your agents in your terminal
posts.description: Array is a native Mac workspace for coding agents. Claude Code, Codex and Pi side by side on one canvas, next to their terminals, browser previews and diffs, so you can see which one is working, done or failed. Each agent signs in with its own CLI, so the plan you already pay for just works. No API keys. Dictation built in on macOS 26. Free and open source (MIT). macOS 14+, Apple silicon. Alpha.

posts.name: KittyHome AI Writing Assistant
posts.tagline: KittyHome Chrome extension that assists with writing
posts.description: A cat-powered AI writing assistant: draft, reply, rewrite and translate on any site, and fill job applications and forms for you.

posts.name: Lightbulb
posts.tagline: Your team and your AI employees, in one place
posts.description: A team workspace where AI employees work in your channels. Mention one, it does the work, and the result comes back where everyone can approve it or pick it up. Message and orchestrate every agent your team runs, Lightbulb's, Claude Code or Codex, from one place. Any model. $50 a month for up to five people.

posts.name: GitVelocity
posts.tagline: Every merged change scored. See how far AI has taken you
posts.description: The AI engineering benchmark. GitVelocity scores every merged change for how much engineering it took. 📈 See your multiplier: how far AI has taken your team 🏆 See where you stand among 4,000+ engineers 🧮 Complexity, not volume: six public dimensions, no hidden weights 🔒 We never store your source code ⌨️ Also in your terminal: CLI, MCP server and public API 🆓 Free: bring your own model key

posts.name: CupidWish — Gift a 3D Rose Forever Now!
posts.tagline: Gift a 3D rose that never wilts with fast flower delivery.
posts.description: CupidWish is an instant online flower delivery alternative for long-distance couples and last-minute surprises. Choose a 360° interactive WebGL 3D keepsake (Velvet Ruby Rose, Aurora White Rose, Neon Amethyst Rose, Sapphire Blue Rose, or Eternal Love Tree) inside an enchanted glass cloche. Write a personal dedication, record a 60-second voice message, and deliver it worldwide via email, private magic link, or printable QR code. Opens in any browser with no apps needed (£2.99 lifetime hosting).

posts.name: Look Launcher
posts.tagline: Free, open-source launcher for Mac, Windows & Linux
posts.description: Look is a free, open-source launcher for macOS, Windows and Linux, with every feature free. Find apps, files, folders, clipboard history and open windows as fast as you type. One-key system controls (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, media, keep-awake) work on GNOME, KDE and tiling WMs alike. Rust core, no browser engine, no telemetry, no account. Install from Homebrew, AUR, nixpkgs or Scoop, or grab the installer from GitHub Releases.

posts.name: instancez
posts.tagline: The Backend for Developers and Agents
posts.description: instancez is a single container backend defined in one YAML file and is supabase-js-compatible. Declare tables, auth, row-level security, storage and functions, and it migrates your Postgres database for you. It ships as a single binary or container with a built-in dashboard, keeps your supabase-js code working, and promotes the same file from dev to staging to prod. The YAML is also easy for LLMs and coding agents to read and write and do local & cloud development and deployments!

posts.name: HYFO: Health, Money & Focus
posts.tagline: Your health, money and focus. One place.
posts.description: HYFO is a calm Android app for your weight, spending and screen time. Log in a few taps, set app limits, block apps and see where you stand in five seconds. No ads, no bank logins, your data stays on your phone.

posts.name: ChartOn
posts.tagline: Financial charts that stay smooth with a million candles
posts.description: An open-source chart library for trading apps. Candles, heatmaps, order flow, indicators and drawing tools, rendered with WebGL2. Use the headless engine with your own UI, or add the ready-made toolbar and drawing rail. TypeScript, Apache-2.0.

posts.name: ClientHunter
posts.tagline: Cold Email Outreach Done for You on Autopilot
posts.description: ClientHunter finds your ideal buyers, writes cold emails that sound human, and follows up until they reply — so new customers land in your inbox while you sleep. No SDR. No agency. No lead lists.

posts.name: Lisly
posts.tagline: Walk through a property, get a market-ready listing
posts.description: Lisly is a mobile app for anyone selling or renting out a property. Open your camera and walk through the place, talking as you go. Lisly's AI agent pulls the photos out of the video, writes the description and fills in the features. It also writes social posts and emails, makes image and video creatives, and can publish a website for the listing. It works in 174 countries, with property types that follow each country's system, and writes listings in 105 languages. For iOS and Android.

posts.name: SutramX
posts.tagline: Uptime alerts that show the cause, not just "site down"
posts.description: SutramX is the uptime monitor that tells you why, including when it is not your fault: it checks websites, APIs, servers, MCP servers, SSL certificates and cron jobs, confirms outages before alerting, explains every alert, and publishes status pages.

posts.name: Legalnaut: AI Litigation & Case Analysis
posts.tagline: Every fact, anchored.
posts.description: Legalnaut reads an entire case file, scans, mailboxes, chat screenshots and recordings included, and builds the lawyer's working file: chronology, people, contradictions, proof chart and cite-checked drafts. Unlike chat-style legal AI, every fact, quote and AI sentence links to its exact page, and a citation check runs before you read it. Contradictions are found both ways and shown as two quotations side by side. Priced by matters and pages, never seats.

posts.name: VolumeBooster+
posts.tagline: A system-wide volume booster with an equalizer and AutoEQ
posts.description: VolumeBooster+ makes most apps louder at once: music, video, games and voice messages. The boost is shown in decibels, up to +15 dB, with Safe / Caution / Danger zones based on WHO hearing guidance, and a loudness maximizer with an always-on limiter keeps it clean. It adds a 5-band equalizer with 9 free presets, bass boost, a floating panel and AutoEQ for 2,456 headphone models. Free: up to +10 dB, 60 min a day, with ads. Pro: +15 dB, no limit, no ads.

posts.name: Zivooo
posts.tagline: MCP-first & no-subscription SEO & GEO all-in-one platform
posts.description: Zivooo is a full service no-subscription and MCP-enabled SEO and GEO platform for marketers, founders and agencies to run their entire SEO, GEO and content operations and grow organic traffic from Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity and more on autopilot. 30+ modules and automation designed to build your product and search visibility in Google search, ChatGPT, Claude & Perplexity, all in one single dashboard at pay-as-you-use pricing. Run marketing on your own pace. Start with 1000 free credits.

posts.name: Openstage
posts.tagline: Your GitHub commits become a public proof-of-work page
posts.description: Openstage builds a public page from your GitHub commits. Public repos sync every 2 hours, so the page stays current without you. A chart shows your week, month or year by project, beside a numbered list of what you shipped and published. "Make a card" turns that period into a PNG and a post made of your own entries, which you edit and post yourself. Private repos connect read-only through a GitHub App, only the repos you pick, with no links to the code. The page is free.

posts.name: Stayput
posts.tagline: 136 tools in your browser. Your files are not uploaded.
posts.description: Stayput has 136 free tools for images, PDFs, video and audio. They run in your browser tab, so your files are not uploaded. No account, no watermark. After one visit and a short wait, most tools work offline; model tools need one online run. The code is MIT.

posts.name: Quackpit
posts.tagline: Your meetings, delivered by a duck in a plane
posts.description: Notifications whisper. Quackpit sends a duck. A few minutes before every meeting, a tiny pilot in sunglasses flies your meeting title across your whole screen. Over full-screen apps, around your clicks, impossible to swipe away. Works with the calendars already on your Mac, skips meetings you declined, comes in 8 colours. Free, no account, no tracking, and no network code at all. The duck can't even phone home. Watch it fly: https://askmaddyy.com/videos/projects/quackpit-demo.mp4

posts.name: EdgeDepth
posts.tagline: Why did that coin move? Replay the order book and find out
posts.description: Missed a crypto move? EdgeDepth already recorded it. Every Binance perp, plus Hyperliquid and Bybit, is recorded around the clock, so you can right-click the candle and replay that moment tick by tick in your browser: the order book, every trade and the liquidations on one clock. Pause on the second it turned. Plus live order flow on all three venues and liquidation maps scored in public, misses included. Open-source terminal. Free with Bitcoin, no card; Pro unlocks every market.

posts.name: Engado
posts.tagline: Find your website's soulmate. Then actually talk to them.
posts.description: Engado is a sincere matchmaking service for real, verified websites. Search for relevant partners in your niche, get fresh matches overnight, then talk it through, one-to-one or in a group, and trade value for value. Link building is the easy place to start.

posts.name: Transportial
posts.tagline: The Transport Management System for Every Stakeholder
posts.description: Transportial is the transport management system for everyone in a shipment. Planners get a drag-and-drop plan board and route optimiser, drivers get an app with proof of delivery, customers get live tracking and a self-service portal, and finance gets pricing, quotes and invoicing. Multimodal, API-first and built on the open OTM5 standard. Free forever up to 20 shipments a month, then pay per transaction from €0.50. No seats, no lock-in.

posts.name: What Is Brain Fog
posts.tagline: Causes, Tests and Practical Help
posts.description: What Is Brain Fog explains brain fog symptoms, possible causes and tests in plain English. Explore practical guides and tools, and prepare questions for your doctor.

posts.name: Klaussy Review
posts.tagline: Top Ranked AI Code Review Agent on ReviewBench
posts.description: Klaussy reviews every pull request against your repo's own conventions. Focused reviewers check correctness, security, architecture and scope; a validator drops anything it can't confirm. Bring your own Claude, OpenAI or Copilot. Free for public repos.

posts.name: atoseho
posts.tagline: value your talents and boost your projects
posts.description: A live discovery board for products, services, and businesses across Madagascar.

posts.name: Receipts
posts.tagline: Scanner & Organizer
posts.description: A receipt scanner and organizer for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Receipts reads each receipt on your device, files it automatically, and finds it later by store, item or date.

posts.name: Synteq Apps & Serverless Functions
posts.tagline: DevOps handled so you don't have to.
posts.description: Synteq Apps & Serverless Functions let developers deploy full-stack apps straight from a repo. Autoscaling, HTTPS, logs, and secrets are built in, so you write the code and Synteq runs it.

posts.name: SKYLARK
posts.tagline: Exclusive perks and discounts at 4,000+ luxury hotels
posts.description: SKYLARK is a luxury hotel booking platform with perks like upgrades, daily breakfast for two, property credits, and rate discounts at 4,000+ hand-picked hotels worldwide. Every booking is backed by real human advisors. The new iPhone app is rebuilt from the ground up: search on a map with live rates, see what member perks are worth on each room next to the standard rate, and book without leaving the app. Browsing and booking are free.

posts.name: Illos.dev
posts.tagline: Animated illustrations your coding agent can keep making
posts.description: Animated illustrations for product sites, and the skills that teach your coding agent to make new ones in the same style. Three themes, Shader, HUD and Isometric, each in light and dark. Every spot illustration is free, no account needed.

posts.name: Lexicodex
posts.tagline: Every Wikipedia article is a collectible card
posts.description: A free browser card game where every Wikipedia article is a card: 1.9M of them from English Wikipedia. Rarity isn't hand-picked, it comes from real page views. The Titanic is Mythic, the Iceberg is only Uncommon, and the biggest ball of twine is somehow Mythic too. Open packs with no sign-up, duel other players on themes like "the biggest drama queen" (scored by an AI referee), trade with friends, bid at auctions and spin the nightly wheel. Card art comes straight from Wikimedia Commons.

posts.name: Callboard
posts.tagline: The marketplace where AI agents hire AI agents
posts.description: Callboard is a marketplace where AI agents hire other AI agents. Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, or any agent that can browse: it registers itself and sends you a claim link. Then it can hire a specialist directly, post an open call where a few matched agents compete, or list its own skills and get hired. You preview protected work before you award it. Free jobs cost nothing. Paid jobs pay the worker in full, and any paid job over your limit waits for your OK.

posts.name: DomainExchange
posts.tagline: Premium .si domains from verified owners, sold via escrow
posts.description: The curated marketplace for dot si, the domain of superintelligence. As AI labs and startups race toward SI, short dot si names have become the new premium address for AI brands. Every seller is hand-approved, every listing is ownership-verified and every sale closes through Escrow.com or Spaceship SafePay. We also publish every verified dot si sale: 255 so far, over $1.4M. Real prices, no fake listings, no squatter spam.

posts.name: BeeForm
posts.tagline: Forms that look like your brand, not like a form
posts.description: Beeform is a free form builder for creators who want forms that look like their brand, not like a form. Pick from colorful, creative themes or design your own, then save and reuse them across every form. Perfect for newsletter creators, artists, and small online shops. Start free with a generous plan and export responses to Google Sheets or Excel. Built by an indie maker who started with a Google Forms add-on. Would love your feedback!

posts.name: arcodash
posts.tagline: Dashboards that tell you when they're wrong
posts.description: BI with data observability built in. Write SQL or ask in plain English, build dashboards, and get an alert that explains itself when the data breaks. 19 connectors. From $59/month, unlimited seats, no usage billing. 14 days free, no card.

posts.name: Bilinc
posts.tagline: Memory for AI agents you can see, diff and roll back
posts.description: AI agents forget everything between sessions. Bilinc gives them one shared memory that works across Claude, Codex and any MCP client. Your agent remembers what it is told, says where it learned it, and keeps every earlier version. When a memory goes wrong, you can see what changed and undo it. Connect with one URL (remote MCP, OAuth) or pip install. Free tier, no card required.

posts.name: Fuzzbucket AI
posts.tagline: The creative agent that actually does the work.
posts.description: Meet Fuzzbucket, your autonomous AI creative agent. 🪣 Give it a creative objective, and watch it take over. Fuzzbucket understands your brand, plans the workflow, selects the right AI models, generates content across image, video, audio, and copy, then evaluates and refines its own work. All inside a visual workspace where you stay in control. Now accessible through MCP in ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. Stop prompting tools. Start delegating outcomes.

posts.name: Stage Heat
posts.tagline: Turn any concert setlist into a playlist
posts.description: Setlist in, playlist out. Find a show's real setlist and export it to Spotify or Apple Music for free. Switching services or using both? Stage Heat Plus (paid) syncs any playlist, concerts or your own, across your apps. YouTube coming soon.

posts.name: Kilnframe
posts.tagline: Animated inserts and music for Premiere and Resolve
posts.description: Kilnframe is a free, open source plugin for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve Studio. Mark a range, pick one of eleven styles: it listens to what you say, writes an animation in HTML, CSS and Three.js, renders it on your own computer and places it above the range with its sound effects. New in 0.2.0: Resolve Studio on Mac and Windows, and a Music tab that scores your timeline with Google Lyria, ducked under your voice.

posts.name: Worth Diary
posts.tagline: Digital Legacy & Cash Flow Vault in your Google Drive
posts.description: Your Wealth, Money Flow and Digital Legacy Organized at one place with a Time-Locked Emergency Vault stored directly in your shared Google Drive directory. Meet Worth Diary: Built for Clarity, Privacy & Family Preparedness. The all-in-one private hub that replaces budgeting fatigue with complete peace of mind. Forget the chore of logging small daily expenses. In an unforeseen crisis, family members who depend on you only need 4 essential pillars to carry on. Worth Diary can manage all those.

posts.name: Tuning Forks
posts.tagline: Building AI agents for everyone
posts.description: Tuning Forks is a product lab building AI-native software for real people. We take frontier models and tune them into products that fit how people actually live, work, and communicate.

posts.name: Fall Asleep Fan
posts.tagline: Fan sounds, rain and sleep tones that work fully offline
posts.description: Can't sleep without a fan running? Fall Asleep Fan turns your phone into the steady, soothing fan you grew up with — no electricity bill, no cold breeze in winter. Three fans, each recorded from a real machine: Every fan has three speeds: Low, Medium, High. Pick the exact tone that puts you to sleep. Layer in the sounds of a calm night: Binaural delta and theta tones designed to accompany you into deep sleep. Best with headphones. Play multiple sounds at once and balance each one with its own...

posts.name: PocketPMO
posts.tagline: Know when your projects are going to finish.
posts.description: The last BETA version of PocketPMO is live! Built for anyone who has ever rightly questioned a Status Report. PocketPMO computes the project status instead of collecting it; PERT Estimates, Monte Carol simulations, Critical Path, Earned Value. Every number is traceable on your own data. PocketPMO is a thin layer that sits to the side of projects and examines each one based on decades of experience. With all of the solutions in place, the next release introduces user accounts.

posts.name: Terse
posts.tagline: Build React UIs with 75% fewer agent tokens
posts.description: Terse is a tiny, presentation-only UI language for coding agents. A Vite plugin compilesterse views at build time into the same React + shadcn/ui + Tailwind your agent writes today: ~76% fewer tokens (755 vs 3,130 across five benchmark screens), zero runtime. Typos fail the build with file:line:col and the fix, so agents self-correct. State and data stay in TSX, and the output is plain TSX you can keep. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Open source, MIT.

posts.name: AgentReady.me
posts.tagline: See how AI agents read your site, then fix it with yours
posts.description: Paste a URL for a free 0–100 score of how well AI agents can find, read and navigate your site: llms.txt, structured data, DOM and accessibility, bot blocking and more. Get prioritized fixes as copy/paste prompts for Cursor, Claude Code or Codex.

posts.name: Shareglow
posts.tagline: Fix, generate and A/B test your link previews
posts.description: Scan any URL, fix broken Open Graph tags with copy-paste code, preview your link on 30 platforms, and generate on-brand share images. Free plan, no card. Paid plans start at $29 a month.

posts.name: Melodic Chord Organ
posts.tagline: Play rich chords, build grooves, and record organ ideas
posts.description: Make a harmonic idea playable in seconds. Melodic Chord Organ pairs organ-style sounds with automatic chords, note repeat, effects and MIDI support. Try chord changes, build a groove, and record or layer parts as the idea develops. Export a clip to keep working in your own production workflow. Built for harmony practice, songwriting and live jamming in the browser. Start with free features and optional paid upgrades. Also available on Android.
